title: Stream binding — agent receives intent via SSE listen()
description: Demonstrates the primary native delivery binding. The agent holds an open SSE connection (GET /v1/agents/{address}/intents/stream). AXME pushes the intent over that connection. The compliance-checker agent reads the payload, validates it against real policy rules, and resumes with a computed result.

agents.description: step 1/1 — stream: receives via SSE, validates change against compliance rules
